The '''Opus''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
